Entries.Original: Hm? This looks like the same kinda device we found at the research facility in Toyama. Yukkie, can you get it to play?
No, the battery's shot. We'll need to replace that part.
Alright, let's bring it back with us and try it out later.
Acquired Recording Device: 1/3
There may be similar devices nearby. Please make sure to retrieve them too.
Acquired Recording Device: 2/3
Acquired Recording Device: 3/3
That should be all the devices around here.
The facilities here are in pretty terrible shape, huh?
Checking the power... It looks like it's up and running.
Some of the auxiliary power sources might have come back online thanks to the restoration of the Mount Goryu power transmission facility.
If the light is on inside, we should investigate it.
The military's stationing room is located inside. From the documents left behind, we may be able to gain valuable contemporary information.
It could come in handy in our fight against the hub-tier Cancer. Let's check it out.
Whoa... It's a mess in here.
The documents are scattered everywhere.
Well, nothing we can do about that. Let's start with the ones that are intact.
I found an old combat report. Looks like there were powerful Cancers in the area, and the military evacuated once they realized they couldn't defeat them all.
So we've got more rough customers out there than just the hub-tier.
So scary...
What, is that the only thing that comes to mind for you? "So scary"? Try to say something a little more constructive.
It seems these enemies inhabit sectors some distance away from the center of the operation area. These sectors are low priority. If you encounter any formidable foes, please consider withdrawing.
See? That's what you call constructive feedback.
Got it. So we need to be extra careful if we come across them.
